name: Be Sweet
description: Be Sweet helps a resident thank someone with a short voice affirmation in their own voice: three questions to help them find their own words, and how to share a Be Sweet story with ECI Loves Goa Baking Co. directly. From the ECI Loves Goa Baking Co. pop-up bakery. Read-only; nothing collected, nothing sold.

permissions.label: Be Sweet prompts and how to share a story
permissions.description: Reads three questions that help you find your own words, and how to tell ECI Loves Goa Baking Co. a Be Sweet story yourself. Calls send no arguments and no identity. No accounts, profiles, purchases or private data; nothing is stored and no data goes to any third party.
